services.name: Our Exhibits
services.desc: We welcome visitors from all backgrounds to come explore Onödowa’ga:’ (Seneca) culture. Start your visit by standing underneath our giant gasto:wä’ while listening to the Hodínöhšö:nih welcome message called Ganö:nyök. From there, learn our creation story before you explore the many exhibits we have to offer. Our museum is proud to highlight the complex histories, stories, and limitless creativity of the Onödowa’ga:’ community, past and present. We welcome you with the Ganönyök.
